subject: english
question:
Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

She was __reluctant__ to say anything to the members of the board.
solution:
The correct answer is ' **Eager** '.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the word** reluctant** is ' **not wanting to do something because you are not sure it is the right thing to do'.**
 
• The meaning of the word **eager** is '** strongly wanting to do or have something**'.​

 **Correct answer:**__ *Eager.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The meaning of the word** impatient** is ' **not able to stay calm and wait for somebody**'.
 
• The meaning of the word **hesitant** is '** slow to speak or act because you are uncertain**'.
 
• The meaning of the word **annoyed** is ' **feeling angry or slightly angry**'.
